_comment: WO-1676 / HEART-003 - THE ONE AUTHORED TABLE FOR HEARTBOUND RESONANCE.
Spec: docs/specs/HEARTBOUND_SKR_RESONANCE_WORK_ORDERS_2026-09-10.md:260-375.
Spec :280 - 'Keep this server-configurable'. Spec :367 - 'Thresholds must be
configuration-driven. Do not scatter them through gameplay code.'
EVERY constant of the resonance curve lives HERE and nowhere else. There is no
second copy in api/_lib/heartbound-resonance.js - that module reads this file and
takes a cfg override on every exported function, so a test can inject a table and
purity is structural rather than promised.
⛔ THERE IS DELIBERATELY NO CANONICAL TWIN UNDER Assets/. Every other data table in
this repo has one, and this one must not: spec :1274 - 'UI contains no staking
calculations' - and WO-1676 §4 records why. A tier threshold the Unity client can
read is a SECOND AUTHORITY on a score product rule 6 (spec :21) makes the backend
authoritative for. The client is told its tier; it never computes one. Adding a twin
here would look like tidiness and would be the exact duplicated-state failure
CLAUDE.md §2/§5/§8/§16 each record a scar from.
⚠ THIS FILE IS THE INTERIM SINGLE HOME, NOT THE FINAL ONE. WO-1676 Q-CONFIG asks the
owner whether these knobs belong on the Command Center tunables rail (option (a): teach
api/_lib/tunable-manifest.js a serverOnly marker) or stay backend-only (option (b): this
file). Until that is ruled, this file is option (b) and it is ONE file, so lifting it
onto the rail later is a data move and not an archaeology exercise.
Ships to Vercel: .vercelignore re-includes /api wholesale (precedent: this folder's
dungeon-manifest.json and sku-catalog.generated.json), so this JSON is present in the
deployment. Verified by reading .vercelignore 2026-09-10.

test/heartbound-resonance.test.js. Change a number here and that suite reds.
Base-unit conversion. Mirrors Assets/_Modules/Wallet/NativeSkrStakeQuery.cs:28-29
(SharePriceScale 1e9, SkrBaseUnits 1e6) - EXCEPT the truncation at :76
(rawTokens / SkrBaseUnits into a long), which throws away every fractional SKR.
WO-1674 requires the snapshot carry raw base units so the backend never repeats it.
Spec :288-298. Increases ramp (trust is earned over pulses); decreases are IMMEDIATE.
That asymmetry is the whole anti-exploit design - spec :306: 'This kills flash-staking
exploits.'
Spec :317-319: StakePower = 1000 x log10(1 + EffectiveStake / 250).
Logarithmic on purpose - spec :313: '500,000 SKR does NOT provide 500 times the
power of 1,000 SKR.'
Spec :339-341: TenurePower = MIN(700, 150 x ln(1 + ContinuousPulseCount / 5)).
